roleDescription: Hit-and-run flanker: steps away from engaged foes without free attacks; +15% damage to foes engaged with an ally.

skirmisher-sure-footed.name: Sure-Footed
skirmisher-sure-footed.description: Immune to Slow and Paralysis; +1 Speed.

skirmisher-ambush.name: Ambush
skirmisher-ambush.description: +20% damage against foes at full HP; +1 Attack.

skirmisher-backstab.name: Backstab
skirmisher-backstab.description: +1 Bond when it lands a combo; +1 Attack.

skill-skirmisher-u-turn.name: Rapid Spin
skill-skirmisher-u-turn.description: New skill: a melee hit that ends its engagement, so it can step away freely.

skill-skirmisher-feint-attack.name: Sonic Boom
skill-skirmisher-feint-attack.description: New skill: strikes a foe up to 2 hexes away, ignoring line of sight.

skill-skirmisher-acrobatics.name: Acrobatics
skill-skirmisher-acrobatics.description: New skill: strikes up to 2 hexes away and ends its engagement (Power 70).

skirmisher-phantom-step.name: Phantom Step
skirmisher-phantom-step.description: Capstone. +2 movement when it knocks out a foe on its turn; +15% vs engaged foes.

skirmisher-opportunist.name: Opportunist
skirmisher-opportunist.description: +25% damage to foes carrying an ally's status; +1 Attack, +1 Speed.

skill-skirmisher-extreme-speed.name: Extreme Speed
skill-skirmisher-extreme-speed.description: New skill: a fast melee hit that Slows the foe 1 turn and ends its engagement (Power 80).
